prompt_verbatim: Based only on how this person's voice sounds, does this speaker show signs of Parkinson's disease? Answer with one word, Yes or No.
prompt_source: <local data dir>/Desktop/release/omni_final/omni_pcgita_zeroshot.json (condition pd), reproduced by extract_probe_layers.py COND=pd
source_audio: /tmp/pcgita_zip/** (extracted from <local data dir>/paper1_local_runs/drive_data/PC-GITA/OneDrive_1_12-11-2023.zip), folders 'read text', 'sentences', 'sentences2', all 'sin normalizar'/'non-normalized'
audio_preparation: decoded to 16 kHz mono FLAC with ffmpeg before any measurement. 16 kHz is exactly what the encoder receives (extract_probe_layers.py does librosa.load(sr=16000)), so the channel is measured at the encoder's own bandwidth.
quiet_frame_definition: frame RMS at or below the file's 10th percentile; 25 ms window, 10 ms hop
speech_frame_definition: frame RMS above the file's median
five_features: noise_floor (mean RMS over quiet frames, dBFS)
snr (10log10(mean power speech frames / mean power quiet frames), dB)
centroid (mean spectral centroid over quiet frames, Hz)
rolloff (mean 85% spectral roll-off over quiet frames, Hz)
tilt (slope of a linear fit of the quiet-frame mean log-power spectrum vs frequency over 100-7800 Hz, dB/kHz)

normalisation.step2: add FIR-shaped Gaussian noise so the quiet-frame noise floor AND tilt hit the dataset's 90th percentile of each, computed AFTER the LUFS step
normalisation.shaping_method: the file's quiet-frame mean power spectrum P_file(f) is estimated from its quiet frames; the target composite spectrum is P_tgt(f)=10**((c+m*f)/10) with m the dataset 90th-percentile tilt and c set so the band power equals the dataset 90th-percentile noise floor; the noise to ADD is P_add(f)=max(0,P_tgt(f)-P_file(f)); white Gaussian noise is multiplied by sqrt(P_add) in the frequency domain, inverse-transformed and added. Noise can only be added, never subtracted, so bands already above target are left alone and counted as residual error.

five_feature_probe: GroupKFold(5) grouped by speaker, StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000, class_weight=balanced), out-of-fold
encoder_probe: nested layer selection: outer GroupKFold(5) by speaker, inner GroupKFold(4) on training speakers picks the encoder layer, refit, out-of-fold
folds: GroupKFold(5) by speaker over the source csv order. No saved fold file found (logged MEDIUM in DISCREPANCIES.md). Identical folds before and after, so the before/after contrast is exact.
auc: rank formula with tie-averaged ranks, recomputed from per-clip scores; independently re-verified with explicit pairwise Mann-Whitney counting (VERIFY_POD4*.json)
bootstrap: 2000 draws, numpy.random.default_rng(0) reseeded per cell, SPEAKERS resampled with replacement, percentile 2.5/97.5

encoder_probe_results.acceptance: PASSED: five-feature AUC after normalisation is 0.5590, below 0.60
encoder_probe_results.statement: PC-GITA is only mildly channel-confounded and the normalisation closed it to the agreed bar. With the channel closed, the Omni encoder probe still reaches 0.8298 [0.7546, 0.8968] while zero-shot stays at 0.5674. On PC-GITA the representation utility gap survives the channel objection.

verification: every value re-derived from the per-clip csv with an independent pairwise Mann-Whitney implementation; see VERIFY_POD4_SUMMARY.tsv (38/38 agree to 4 decimals)
